'''Okuda Monarchism''' is a source-listed branch of monarchism.

The current source list gives only the name and parent ideology. It should not be merged with the [[Okuda Shogunate]] or post-1994 Okuda Empire material until a dedicated source review confirms continuity.

== Canon Limits ==

Do not assign Okuda Monarchism a party, dynasty, state program, founding date, or pre-1994 political role until stronger source material is reviewed.
